items.headline: Big personality and big things for Jason Eck at New Mexico
items.description: In his second season with the Lobos, Eck has the university thinking about a bright future.

items.headline: No. 24 Oklahoma hosts New Mexico in Week 3
items.description: New Mexico (2-0) at No. 24 Oklahoma (1-1), Sept. 19 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Scottre Humphrey's 2 TDs power New Mexico over Mercyhurst 70-7
items.description: — Scottre Humphrey rushed for 110 yards and two touchdowns as New Mexico scored a program-record 42 points in the second quarter and rolled past Mercyhurst 70-7 on Saturday.

items.headline: Laubstein, Glasgow propel New Mexico to 38-7 victory over Central Michigan in season opener for both
items.description: — James Laubstein had two touchdown runs and Grant Glasgow kicked three field goals to lead New Mexico to a 38-7 victory over Central Michigan on Saturday night in a season opener for both teams.

items.headline: College football coaching carousel 2026: Who to watch for the next big job opening
items.description: After an unprecedented cycle of changes, what can we expect in 2026?

items.headline: New Mexico starting QB Jack Layne to sit out season due to injury
items.description: New Mexico starting quarterback Jack Layne will sit out the 2026 season as he prepares to undergo a second surgery on his throwing elbow.
